pages.summary: Reorganized item access, overflow and component patches into task-focused sections and tables. Corrected with_component to return Result<ItemResource, StackError> and separated resource editing from the exchange.
Removed benchmark measurements, engine test commands and fork-history language. Clarified pagination changes, transfer limits and additional handler calls when a partial move is retried.
Removed fork-history language, marked inline examples as ignored Rust and clarified that allocation-free provider-free polling applies to a reused cached result.

Removed fork-history language, redundant hook-count commentary and a broken hook-notes link. Added sections for reads, clicks and transactional slot writes, and marked uncompiled inline Rust correctly.

Changed the introduction and dependency instructions to address the reader directly and marked the inline declaration as uncompiled Rust. Retained the verified registration validation and shared-type requirements.
